cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: For Stability’s Sake
cards.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Leave the director's name on the launch programme. The department heads need someone above them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her resignation is in the printer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Put it in my drawer. Without her, they'll each claim the launch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're asking which of them gets her opening speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll read it on her behalf. Give them equal introductions; nobody inherits the microphone.

mechanism: A teaches its pupil to suppress a resignation and stage equal deputy treatment so a departing leader apparent authority still stabilizes rivals.
confusable: Not merely avoiding bad news: preserving the balance among competing department heads is the stated reason.
comparison: Resignation and microphone succession versus financial shortfall and public leadership confidence.
